# Psalm 45 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 45:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Gird your-sword on-[your]-thigh, O-mighty-one, [in] your-splendor and-your-majesty.
- **LOGOS:** Gird your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and majesty!
- **PNEUMA:** Put on Your sword, O mighty warrior! You are so glorious, so majestic!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
